name: lv_obj_refresh_style

ownership.argument: Object is borrowed and mutated; selector/property are scalars. Receiver and its resource sources must survive synchronous callbacks.

provenance.source: Exact .139 AP instruction/call-site inspection and source-compiled Unicorn probes; see EVID-RESOURCE-4139-007.

notes: Explicitly refreshes supported effective image-bearing style properties without replacing style pointers or selectors. Native callbacks may run synchronously. UI-owner thread only, outside IRQ lock; no GPU drain or physical display acceptance is established.
